avis-title:
They took the leap.
Here's what they think.
test-1: "Delivered in 4 days, exactly as quoted. The site is beautiful, but above all it's right: every screen does precisely what we defined in the brief. Several users asked us who did the design."
test-2: "I'm not technical at all and I was afraid I wouldn't keep up. Two calls, one brief, and everything was live on Thursday. They turn your ideas into simple decisions, and whenever I have a doubt, I get an answer the same day."
test-3: "Four days from brief to launch, and you can't tell it was rushed — because it wasn't. The site feels like our brand: clean, fast, nothing extra. Orders come in from outside France and checkout has been flawless."
faq-1-a: As soon as we receive your content and first payment, we start immediately. Day 1: brief & mockup. Day 2: validation & development. Days 3 and 4: finalization, testing and launch. Simple, fast, contractually guaranteed.
faq-2-a: Our maintenance covers everything your site needs to stay performant and secure:
faq-3-q: What if I'm not satisfied with the result?
faq-3-a: We offer unlimited revisions during the design phase until you're 100% happy. And if you're still not satisfied within 14 days of delivery, we'll give you a full refund. Zero risk for you.
faq-4-q: I don't have texts or photos · can you help?
faq-4-a: Absolutely. We offer a copywriting and royalty-free image selection service. We can start from scratch and build all your brand content. Just mention it in your brief and we'll include it in the quote.
faq-5-q: Will I be able to update my site myself?
faq-5-a: It depends on the delivery method you choose. With custom code (our default offer), we hand over all your site's source files: for content changes, our maintenance plan is there, 2 requests per month included, replies within 48h. If you'd rather manage things yourself, every plan can also be delivered on WordPress (+€250): you then edit texts, images and pages yourself, with drag-and-drop, without depending on a developer for every change. Hands-on training is included at delivery.
faq-6-q: Will my site be visible on Google?
faq-6-a: All our sites include basic technical SEO (meta tags, speed, structure). Advanced SEO is available as an option: keyword audit, page optimization and Search Console submission. Your site will be indexed from day one.
faq-7-q: What technology do you use to build my site?
faq-7-a: It depends on what you need. By default, we hand-code every site, no theme or recycled page, which is what lets us push hard on speed and SEO. If you want to be able to update your site yourself after delivery (text, images, new pages), we can also build it on WordPress, with a drag-and-drop interface and training included. We also work with Wix or tools like Lovable when the project calls for it. Either way, the design stays custom-made for your business, never a generic template.
